description: The immutable, client-frozen metadata part of POST /v1/ingest (plan Sections 7.2 and 7.3). Serialized as RFC 8785 canonical JSON with no floating-point values, bounded to 65,536 canonical bytes. The envelope excludes server commit time, per-attempt authorization epoch/key/timestamp, the per-attempt signature, and any server attempt correlation: those live in the request signature parameters and the signed receipt, so a retry outside the authorization window changes nothing about occurrence or attestation identity. Unknown optional fields are retained inside signed bytes and their semantics ignored (plan Section 7.1); the reserved names below are rejected outright because freezing per-attempt or server material in the envelope would break that exact property.

adapter_artifact_id.description: The adapter's opaque identifier for the source artifact; an input to the artifact hash (plan Section 7.4).

adapter_id.description: Identifier of the adapter that projected the artifact; an input to the artifact hash (plan Section 7.4).

adapter_projection_version.description: Version of the adapter's projection; preserved in provenance and an input to the artifact hash (plan Sections 7.1 and 7.4).

artifact_kind.description: Kind of source artifact this occurrence projects (plan Section 7.3).

attestation_id.description: Deterministic upload-attestation identifier (plan Section 7.4): H("attestation-v1", occurrence_id, uploader_client, request_id). Reproduced by retries of the same frozen request; distinct for a distinct uploader or request.

blob_digest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical uncompressed payload bytes (plan Section 7.4). The one digest that names a blob (STO-001); the server always recomputes it while streaming (VAL-004).

capture_time.description: UTC time the client captured (discovered and spooled) this chunk. Uploader-asserted provenance (plan Section 7.3; PI-07).

client_build.description: Hypothetical v1.1 additive field pinned by the compatibility corpus: the building client's version token. Correlation only; never an identity input, so old readers ignore its semantics while retaining it inside the signed canonical envelope bytes.

compressed_size.description: Size in bytes of the payload as transported under `transport_encoding`. Equals `uncompressed_size` when the encoding is `identity`. Policy limits (VAL-003) bound the value at commit time; the schema bound is the no-float integer discipline.

envelope_creation_time.description: UTC time the client froze this envelope (plan Section 7.3). Frozen with the spool entry; retries reuse the same bytes and this same timestamp.

envelope_version.description: Envelope schema major version (plan Section 7.1). Integer, currently 1; an unknown major fails closed. New optional fields land inside v1; new required or redefined fields require v2.

generation.description: Source generation of this artifact snapshot (plan Sections 7.3 and 7.4): replacement, truncation, or incompatible rewrite starts a fresh UUIDv7 generation and preserves both histories (EC-02). An input to the occurrence hash.

id_source.description: Whether `upstream_session_id` came from the harness or was adapter-minted for a missing harness session ID (plan Section 7.4; a synthetic ID is never inferred from a path name).

incoming_checksum.description: Checksum of the payload bytes as transported — the incoming representation, after the declared transport encoding (plan Section 7.3). A secondary integrity check, never promoted to content identity (PI-02).

incoming_checksum_algorithm.description: Algorithm of `incoming_checksum`; SHA-256 only in v1.

inference_request_id.description: Optional inference-request correlation identifier (plan Section 7.3; Phase 9 consumes it).

occurrence_id.description: Deterministic occurrence identifier (plan Section 7.4): H("occurrence-v1", session_hash, artifact_hash, generation, range_kind, range_start, range_end, blob_digest). The server re-derives and refuses a mismatch.

orchestrator_attempt_id.description: Optional orchestrator attempt correlation identifier (plan Section 7.3; joined exactly, never inferred, per EC-13).

origin_client_id.description: Installation that captured the source. The session namespace is scoped by tenant and origin client, so cloned harness UUIDs never merge (plan Section 7.4; EC-03).

parent_session_id.description: Optional upstream identifier of the parent session, within the same harness (plan Section 7.3). Correlation only: never an identity-hash input.

protocol_version.description: Wire protocol family of the route (plan Section 7.1). Integer, currently 1; an unknown major fails closed.

range_end.description: Inclusive end coordinate of this chunk in the generation's source stream. Ranges sit inside the occurrence identity (plan Section 7.4), so overlapping, gapped, or re-declared ranges produce distinct deterministic occurrences (PI-05).

range_kind.description: Whether the range coordinates are byte offsets or event ordinals (plan Section 7.4).

range_start.description: Inclusive start coordinate of this chunk in the generation's source stream. `range_start` at most `range_end` and consistency with the declared sizes are server-side validation (VAL-002), not schema syntax.

request_id.description: The frozen upload request identifier (plan Sections 7.3 and 7.4): a UUIDv7 generated when the spool entry is created, reused across every retry, and bound into the envelope, attestation, receipt, and error bodies (ERR-025). A correlation handle, not a security identity.

source_time.description: Optional UTC timestamp embedded in or derived from the source itself, when one exists (plan Section 7.5). Omitted, never nulled, when the source carries none. Uploader-asserted provenance (PI-07).

storage_profile.description: Named canonical storage encoder the server must produce for this occurrence's blob (plan Sections 7.5 and 7.6). Declared in the envelope so the stored form is pinned per occurrence.

trace_id.description: Optional provider trace correlation identifier (plan Section 7.3; CAP-008).

transport_encoding.description: Wire encoding of the payload part of this request (plan Section 7.6). The server decodes exactly one declared encoding; a misdeclaration makes the decoded canonical bytes diverge and the request fails (PI-01).

uncompressed_size.description: Size in bytes of the canonical uncompressed payload. Enforced against the bytes the decoder actually produces (VAL-003; PI-03).

uploader_client_id.description: Installation presenting this request. May differ from the origin client when a relay or mirror uploads on the origin's behalf (plan Sections 7.4 and 7.5; EC-05A).

upstream_session_id.description: The harness's own session identifier, or the adapter-minted stand-in when `id_source` is `synthetic`. Opaque UTF-8, at most 1,024 bytes, never case-folded or Unicode-normalized; hashed into identity, never embedded in object keys.

title: Agent Archivist canonical ingest envelope (envelope_version 1)

x-archivist.mediaTypeVersionParameter: tracks envelope_version: the media-type parameter and the field must agree, so a v2 envelope is framed as version=2 and an old server rejects at the framing layer before parsing the body — part of the fail-closed major rule (plan Section 7.1)
x-archivist.signedBy: ingest-attempt-v1 signature parameters over the whole request (schemas/v1/ingest-request.json); the envelope itself never carries per-attempt material
